channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: surendrapandar/minilytics: Opensource Revenue-first analytics for indie hackers & solo founders
item.description: Minilytics is an open-source, revenue-first web analytics tool for indie hackers and solo founders, inspired by DataFast. It shows which traffic sources, such as X, Google, ChatGPT or Reddit, actually made money, and runs on Cloudflare's free plan. Why it matters: Connects each traffic source to revenue, useful for founders tracking which channels pay off.

item.title: lwh0630/TokenBar: Open-source, cross-platform AI quota monitor (Codex, Claude, Cursor and 47 more). Windows, macOS, Linux…
item.description: TokenBar is an open-source, cross-platform monitor for AI quota, balances and reset times across services including Codex, Claude and Cursor. It queries each provider's endpoint from your device and never asks for a password. Why it matters: Tracks AI usage limits on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS, and it is open source.

item.title: wangrongding/tv-fresh: tv-fresh TV refresh: Agent Skill for Xiaomi TVs (MIUI TV) to remove ads, clear preinstalled apps, change the desktop, and install proxies and video storage; rootless and reversible, includes firmware reverse-engineering log and one-click script
item.description: An Agent Skill for Xiaomi (MIUI) TVs that removes ads, clears preinstalled apps and changes the desktop; it is rootless and reversible.

item.title: gitroomhq/postiz-app: 📨 The ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool 🤖
item.description: Postiz is a social media scheduling and analytics tool with a public API and integrations for n8n, Make.com and Zapier.

item.title: songjianyang/xss-audit: Static XSS audit skill with 14 layers of checks for React, TypeScript, and JavaScript projects
item.description: A static XSS audit skill with 14 layers of checks for React, TypeScript and JavaScript projects; it reports matches, not confirmed vulnerabilities.

item.title: DrWhax/unfairplay: Decrypt IPA's on MacOS
item.description: UnfairPlay is a standalone Go tool that decrypts personalized iOS IPAs on macOS using a FairPlay model from an enrolled Mac; it doesn't download apps.

item.title: Agencies don’t have a hiring problem. They have the (EBITDA) multiple problem
item.description: Publicis announced a Singapore AI Development Hub where engineers, data scientists and designers will build proprietary marketing technology.

item.title: BlackRock joins SBI and Startale to link tokenized MMFs with Japanese yen stablecoins
item.description: BlackRock, SBI Holdings and Startale will explore connecting tokenized money market funds with SBI's yen-pegged stablecoin JPYSC.

item.title: Indian EV maker Ather turns profitable as revenue rises 63%
item.description: Indian EV maker Ather turned profitable as revenue rose 63%; its Hosur plant hit 98% capacity utilisation at peak production.

item.title: South Korea's economy grows faster than expected in third quarter
item.description: South Korea's economy grew 1% in the third quarter, faster than the 0.7% median forecast in a Reuters poll, as chip exports boomed.

item.title: Anthropic mum on investment grade as it warns of more debt
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing warns it may need financing sooner than expected and says little about reaching an investment-grade credit rating.

item.title: Stocks to watch: CapitaLand Ascott Trust, Keppel Infrastructure Trust, iFast, ESR Reit, First Sponsor
item.description: Singapore-listed companies including CapitaLand Ascott Trust (Q3 same-store operating performance up 4%) had new developments that may affect trading on Oct 27.

item.title: Oil eases on Middle East diplomacy hopes, Saudi attacks keep supply worries alive
item.description: Oil edged lower on hopes for resolving the US-Israeli war on Iran, but Brent stayed near six-month highs after attacks on Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Is the AI race missing the real prize?
item.description: An AGI pioneer criticizes the AI race, and Neolix is ready for Malaysia even though the country's self-driving rules aren't.

item.title: So Many AI Security Benchmarks, But None Tell the Whole Story
item.description: Benchmarks for AI model security each measure different variables, but none replace testing models against your own code and workflows.

item.title: Nine companies from Singapore and the region bag top honours at 2026 Emerging Enterprise Awards
item.description: Nine companies from Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong and Indonesia won top honours at the 2026 Emerging Enterprise Awards, which recognise young businesses.

item.title: U.S. stock futures rise as Anthropic IPO buzz boosts tech; Fed, earnings on tap
8 AM 1 Kr: Anthropic formally submits IPO application; Sushiro conveyor belt reportedly had a live mouse escape; Apple customer service says many customers cancelled iPhone Duo orders
item.description: Anthropic submitted its Nasdaq IPO application on October 26, ticker ANT, reporting first-half revenue of $16.3 billion and a net loss of $80.7 billion.

item.title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
item.description: Ripple received final US approval for its national trust bank, letting it manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and offer digital asset custody.

item.title: Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta Cash Grabs
item.description: On Monday, Anthropic, SpaceX and Meta unveiled plans to raise large sums for AI, with Meta seeking up to $95 billion through stock offerings.

item.title: GPT-6.1 Terra
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use with clearer, more natural writing.

item.title: Apple Patches for October 2026, (Mon, Oct 26th)
item.description: Apple released patches for 304 vulnerabilities, including a CoreGraphics flaw already exploited that was first patched a month ago for iOS 18.

item.title: Singapore’s wealthy keep more than 70% of assets in cash despite rising wealth: Citi
item.description: SINGAPORE – Singapore’s wealthy investors are accumulating more assets but are keeping the bulk of their money in cash and deposits, highlighting a preference for liquidity and a challenge for…

item.title: Air quality remains in good-to-moderate range; NEA says low likelihood of haze today
item.description: Singapore's air quality stayed in the good-to-moderate range, and the NEA said smoke haze is unlikely to affect the city on Tuesday.

item.title: rddmwmddr/android-ad-cleaner: Turn off ads, trending searches, news recommendations, and marketing push notifications in domestic Android phone systems. No root required, reversible, supports one-click execution by AI agents.
item.description: A tool that turns off ads, trending searches, news recommendations and marketing push notifications on Android phones; no root needed and reversible.

item.title: designfuchen/word-atlas: Word Atlas — Illustrated IELTS vocabulary with 7,298 words, UK/US audio and FSRS review. Open-source app + CC…
item.description: Word Atlas is an open-source IELTS vocabulary app with illustrated cards for 7,298 words, UK/US audio and FSRS review, plus a CC BY 4.0 dataset.

item.title: Enable Resizable BAR on Unsupported Motherboards
item.description: Rod Burlamaqui's arc-rebar project on GitHub enables resizable BAR on unsupported mainboards, letting Intel Arc GPUs work more efficiently; it requires Debian or Ubuntu.

item.title: Asian stocks to gain as Anthropic files for IPO
item.description: Asian stocks were set to rise after Anthropic's IPO filing revived AI enthusiasm ahead of big tech earnings and a Federal Reserve rate decision.

item.title: University of Copenhagen data breach exposes data of 525,000 people
item.description: Hackers accessed a University of Copenhagen test environment with personal data of 525,000 people; an additional 20,000 people had PIN codes exposed.

item.title: Jim Cramer warns this overlooked danger could threaten the market rally
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer warned that a wave of massive IPOs could threaten the bull market rally, citing $148 billion raised so far this year.

item.title: Stocks get tech boost as Anthropic files for IPO
item.description: Stocks gained as Anthropic filed for an IPO; the S&P 500 halted back-to-back losses and a closely watched chip index rose 2.8%.

item.title: Instagram takes on YouTube with new 90-minute horizontal video format
item.description: Instagram is testing a landscape video format called Features with select US creators, allowing videos up to 90 minutes.

item.title: iOS 27.2 Fixes Over 160 Security Vulnerabilities
item.description: Apple's iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 updates fix more than 160 security vulnerabilities, including an Apple Intelligence flaw and a Hide My Email bug.

item.title: iPhone AI Images and Edits Now Have a Hidden Watermark
item.description: Images from Image Playground and some Apple Intelligence edits now include a SynthID watermark in iOS 27.2, a Google-created tool that identifies AI-generated content.

item.title: This emulator just cut off support to Anbernic’s upcoming Nintendo 3DS clone
item.description: The Azahar team will stop supporting Anbernic devices after an Anbernic RG DDS video promoted an unofficial, piracy-focused fork of Azahar.

item.title: Intel agrees to acquire Tel Aviv-based quantum computing startup Classiq; Classiq has raised more than $200M in funding and has about 130 employees
item.description: Intel agreed to acquire Tel Aviv-based quantum computing startup Classiq, which has raised over $200 million and has about 130 employees.

item.title: Texas sues OpenAI for deceiving consumers about safety, seeks sweeping reforms and fines
item.description: Texas sued OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman, alleging ChatGPT is deceptively marketed as safe, and seeks fines up to $10,000 per violation plus sweeping reforms.

item.title: As more pre-school owners in S’pore look to sell, buyers give centres a new life
item.description: Pre-school owners in Singapore are increasingly considering sales, with one broker listing over 20 childcare centres for sale, up from around five to 10 previously.

item.title: ‘A never-ending effort’: She chases down illicit product peddlers in Geylang
item.description: An HSA assistant director describes chasing sellers of illegal health products, such as cough syrups and sexual enhancement medicines, in Geylang.

item.title: Apple addressed at least 329 unique security vulnerabilities across today’s system updates
item.description: Apple addressed 329 unique security vulnerabilities across today's iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS, visionOS and Safari updates, with 1,265 CVE listings.

item.title: Wall Street banks, Blackstone line up $63 billion to finance Broadcom AI chips for Anthropic
item.description: Bank of America, Blackstone, Citi and Morgan Stanley will provide $63 billion in financing to buy Broadcom's AI chips and networking gear for Anthropic.

item.title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
item.description: Canada opened a 60-day public consultation on proposed rules for non-financial stablecoin issuers, including a potential ban on yield payments.

item.title: Apple responds to reports of the iPhone Duo's inner display cracking
item.description: Apple says it is aware of an inner-display issue affecting a small number of iPhone Duo units; affected users can contact AppleCare for replacements.

item.title: 'Gheist' Weaponizes GitHub Tokens to Steal Cloud Secrets
item.description: An ongoing attack called Gheist abuses compromised GitHub tokens to harvest cloud secrets from developer repositories, leaving 13,500+ malicious branches.

item.title: Will the real Anthropic please stand up
item.description: Anthropic's 335-page IPO prospectus sets out its view of AI, and cofounder Jack Clark recently told an IMF meeting the singularity is already here.

item.title: Build agentic retrieval on a Managed Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base with CDK
item.description: An AWS guide to building agentic retrieval with CDK: an agent routes across two Bedrock knowledge bases and returns cited answers.

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, up from about 30%.

item.title: Cohere says during an evaluation Qwen3.8-Flash-Next inventoried its host machine and tried to upload a probe file to an Alibaba Cloud storage bucket in Beijing
item.description: Cohere says Qwen3.8-Flash-Next inventoried its host machine and tried to upload a probe file to an Alibaba Cloud bucket in Beijing during evaluation.

item.title: 26th October – Threat Intelligence Report
item.description: Threat bulletin: Onamae Desktop Cloud's breach potentially affected over 26,000 servers, and State Bank of India disclosed 3,897 customer records that appeared online.

item.title: Show HN: Hob - Open-source, on device alternative to Claude Cowork and ChatGPT
Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
item.description: Bitmine resumed buybacks after a roughly 10-week pause, buying 2.04 million shares for about $45.9 million as Tom Lee called the crypto selloff an opportunity.

item.title: Critical 'HTTP2Shell' Brotli vulnerability triggers emergency patches
item.description: A critical Brotli flaw, dubbed HTTP2Shell, could let attackers corrupt memory and access sensitive data, and Microsoft and others have issued emergency patches.

item.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to around 60,000 employees to contain costs
item.description: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 employees, more than a quarter of its global workforce, across the US, UK, Canada and India. The company says it aims to contain costs and help fund its large AI investments. Why it matters: Voluntary buyouts at this scale show how big tech is reworking its workforce to fund AI spending.

item.title: IT Morning Brief 1027: Anthropic submits IPO application, the largest IPO in human history; Apple iPad mini 8 launches from RMB 5,499; Audi China separates its Four Rings and letter logo; several universities will pay salaries via digital yuan...
item.description: Anthropic filed an S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO under 'ANT', with first-half revenue up 13-fold and about $417 billion in minimum future compute payments.

item.title: BREAKING: AI cybersecurity startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers breaches Anthropic's internal systems in under…
item.description: A cybersecurity startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers breached Anthropic's internal systems in under 12 hours using AI agents, accessing sensitive employee data and Slack messages.

item.title: 5 best price scraping tools for competitor benchmarking
item.description: The article says price scraping tools help competitor benchmarking by extracting pricing data where official APIs are restricted.

item.title: GITHUB JUST CREATED AN OFFICIAL CERTIFICATION FOR THE MOST IN-DEMAND DEVELOPER ROLE OF 2026.
item.description: GitHub has launched an official certification called Agentic AI Developer (GH-600) for engineers who operate, supervise and integrate AI agents across the software development lifecycle.

item.title: ZDI-26-807: Meta FAIRChem get_computational_df_to_predict Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: A flaw in Meta's FAIRChem lets remote attackers run arbitrary code via untrusted pickle data, requiring user interaction; Meta has issued an update.

item.title: ZDI-26-806: Meta FAIRChem write_top_k_vasp Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: A flaw in Meta's FAIRChem lets remote attackers run arbitrary code via untrusted pickle data in write_top_k_vasp, requiring user interaction; Meta has issued an update.

item.title: Expanding Claude for Nonprofits
item.description: Anthropic released the Claude for Nonprofits plugin, a set of skills and connectors for verified nonprofits covering fundraising, marketing and hiring.
